This test correctly captures the buggy behavior and will fail if the bug is fixed (i.e., if `do_first` becomes pickleable).", "final_test": "import pytest
import pickle
import jinja2.filters

def test_do_first_not_pickleable():
    """Test that jinja2.filters.do_first is not pickleable due to the bug.

    This test should FAIL at the current commit and PASS once the bug
    (incorrect __name__/__qualname__ on async_variant decorated functions)
    is fixed, allowing the function to be pickled.
    """
    with pytest.raises(pickle.PicklingError) as excinfo:
        pickle.dumps(jinja2.filters.do_first)
    # The error message should indicate that the function cannot be pickled
    # and specifically mention 'jinja2.filters.sync_do_first' as the unpickleable object.
    assert "Can't pickle" in str(excinfo.value)
    assert "jinja2.filters.sync_do_first" in str(excinfo.value)
